Mermaid 12.2.0, vendored for offline flowcharts and cycles.

Source package: https://registry.npmjs.org/mermaid/-/mermaid-12.2.0.tgz
API documentation: https://mermaid.js.org/config/usage.html

The self-contained distribution mermaid.min.js is unmodified and includes its bundled dependency
notices. The package's MIT LICENSE is included alongside it. No CDN or module imports are required.
